# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free New Zealand self-employed tax calculator: enter income and expenses to see income tax, ACC earners' levy, optional student loan repayment and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
